title: Mean reversion: Buy, re-arm, Buy again, then a direct flip to Sell
purpose: Entry thresholds are inclusive; the latch is re-armed by a bar inside the re-arm band; a direct flip from one extreme to the other signals at once.

provenance.derived_by: by hand, from the strategy document and the fixture bars; not copied from any run of the tool
sources: docs/strategies/mean_reversion.md section 4 (the latch) and section 6 (worked example)
derivation: bar 4: window 10 10 10 6, mean 9, variance 3, z = -3/sqrt(3) = -sqrt(3) = -1.732 <= -1.5: Buy (event_index 3)
bar 5: window 10 10 6 9, mean 35/4, variance 43/16, z = 1/sqrt(43) = 0.1525, |z| <= 0.5: inside the re-arm band, latch neutral
bar 6: window 10 6 9 2, mean 27/4, variance 155/16, z = -1.5261 <= -1.5 and latch neutral: Buy (event_index 5)
bar 7: window 6 9 2 30, mean 47/4, variance 1875/16, z = 1.6859 >= 1.5 and latch lower: direct flip, Sell (event_index 6)

irrational_double.why: irrational value, rounded to 17 significant digits; the C++ computes it in IEEE double (about 1e-16 relative), so a few ulps of a value below 40 is about 1e-14. 1e-12 leaves two orders of margin and is far below any difference that could change a decision here
